market_regime_interaction.classifier_effect: Market breadth/regime labels are passed through as context and do not gate or downgrade an entry_state or entry_action.
market_regime_interaction.rule_level_exception: The contemporaneous volatility median is a technical input to R2/R7; it is not a market-regime/breadth gate.

conditions_that_can_change_without_ma50_: A positive return or upper-half market-relative momentum can produce R8 SELLING_PRESSURE_EASING while momentum remains negative.
A positive 20-day momentum flip plus one existing R6 independent confirmation can produce EARLY_REVERSAL_CANDIDATE before an MA20 reclaim.
MA50 and MA200 are not inputs to the existing classifier decision table.
